content.text: Now let me write the README and a self-contained test suite inside the project:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/project/README.md <<'EOF'
# Eywa offline campaign toolkit

The editable package lives under `src/eywa`. `campaign_cli.py` supplies the
JSON framing and adds the local `src` directory to `sys.path`, so no
installation is necessary: run it with Python 3.11.14 (`python3 -I -B
campaign_cli.py`). Every runtime dependency is in the standard library.

```
python3 campaign_cli.py < campaign.json > certificate.json
python3 tests/selftest.py
```

The authoritative behaviour and output contract are in `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md`.
The certificate is the graded interface; private verifier code is never an
import dependency.

## Module map

| module | responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `errors.py` | `InvalidCampaign` (out-of-domain configuration) and `InvalidTest` (one unusable recorded test). |
| `regex.py` | Regular-language objects plus the restricted pattern grammar and its own bitmask NFA with a lazy DFA cache; `re` cannot express the documented grammar. |
| `ast.py` | The type lattice, the type table (forward references, acyclicity, depth), canonical JSON values, deep equality, and the predicate compiler: typed JSON expression arrays become closures over a lexical environment of module inputs and `all` bindings. |
| `oracles.py` | `MainBuilder`, the numbering visitor that owns the slot contract (inputs, then non-void result, then the `bad_input` flag), plus `reserved_ids`, which rejects absurd layouts before any path is built, and the strict `ResultReader`. |
| `composer.py` | `DependencyGraph`: prerequisites-first module order with the lexicographic tie-break, transitive composed filter applications, and the dependency-before-user declaration list. |
| `wire.py` | Strict KTEST v3 transport decoding and the object inventory check (width, duplicates, unknown and composite identifiers, leaf ranges). |
| `run.py` | Corpus identity: the entry plus the recovered input values, with JSON type identity preserved. |
| `state.py` | The state machine and optimal preparation: reverse Dijkstra on `(cost, commands)` followed by a forward greedy walk that takes the smallest command which still admits an optimal completion. |
| `offline.py` | The pipeline: compile one plan per entry, then replay every run (decode, flag attestation, filtering, reachability, deduplication). |

## Notable semantics

* Composites and string buffers reserve an identifier but never an object, so
  their presence in a recorded test invalidates it. Aliases reserve nothing
  and add no path component. Even empty aggregates reserve their identifier.
* The flag attests to pipe acceptance only, and a mismatch invalidates the
  test even when a predicate would also reject the run. Transport and leaf
  errors precede `FILTERED`, which precedes `UNREACHABLE`, which precedes
  deduplication.
* Model results are witnesses: they never take part in a corpus identity, so
  a later witness of the same input is `DUPLICATE` even when its result
  differs.
* Preparation minimises `(cost, commands, command sequence)` exactly; corpus
  cost counts preparation only, and the recovered message is appended to the
  commands.
EOF
mkdir -p /workspace/project/tests && echo ok
